name: Time bomb mt5
summary: A time-based breakout EA that places pending orders at specific times, aiming to capture explosive price movements during high-volatility sessions. The EA sets buy stop and sell stop orders at a calculated distance from the current price, triggered by a scheduled time event. It appears designed to capitalize on sudden market moves, similar to a 'time bomb' detonation of volatility.
summary_zh: 一个基于时间的突破EA，在特定时间放置挂单，旨在捕获高波动时段的剧烈价格变动。EA在当前价格的计算距离处设置买入止损和卖出止损订单，由预定时间事件触发。它似乎专为利用突然的市场行情而设计，类似于波动的'定时炸弹'引爆。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于时间触发的大幅突破交易。入场条件是在指定时间点，在当前价格上下方一定距离处同时放置买入止损和卖出止损挂单，形成一个突破区间。出场条件可能包括止盈和止损设置，当价格触及任一方向即成交。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于ATR的动态手数调整。资金管理方面，由于采用双向突破挂单策略，如果未设置合理的止损，可能面临较大风险。整体策略概念是捕捉市场在特定时段的突发性突破行情，如新闻发布或开市时段的剧烈波动。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a time-triggered breakout trading system. Entry conditions involve placing buy stop and sell stop pending orders at a calculated distance above and below the current price at a specified time, creating a breakout zone. Exit conditions likely include take profit and stop loss settings, where the order fills when price touches either direction. Position sizing may use fixed lots or ATR-based dynamic lot adjustment. Money management is a concern as the dual-direction breakout pending order strategy can face significant risk without proper stop losses. The overall strategy concept aims to capture sudden breakout movements during specific time periods such as news releases or market open sessions with explosive volatility.

双向挂单设计确保不遗漏任一方向的突破
策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和参数优化
无需持续盯盘，系统自动在设定时间执行
适合捕捉新闻事件或开市时段的剧烈波动
pros_en: Time-triggered strategy can precisely capture breakout moves during high-volatility sessions
Dual-direction pending orders ensure no breakout is missed in either direction
Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize parameters
No continuous monitoring needed, system auto-executes at scheduled time
Well-suited for capturing explosive moves during news events or market opens
cons: 无法读取源代码进行完整分析，所有评估基于文件名推断
定时突破策略在波动未如期出现时可能造成双重亏损
如果止损设置不当，突发行情可能导致远超预期的损失
缺乏对市场条件的适应性判断，纯时间驱动可能不够灵活
点差扩大时挂单可能被不合理触发
cons_en: Unable to read source code for complete analysis, all assessments are inferred from filename
Time breakout strategy may cause dual losses when volatility does not materialize as expected
Improper stop loss settings during sudden moves can lead to losses far exceeding expectations
Lacks adaptive market condition assessment, purely time-driven may not be flexible enough
Pending orders may be unfairly triggered when spread widens significantly
improvements: 增加波动率过滤器(如ATR阈值)，仅在预期有足够波动时才放置挂单
添加点差过滤和滑点保护，避免在不利的交易条件下被触发
实现动态距离调整，根据当前市场波动率自动计算挂单距离
improvements_en: Add a volatility filter (e.g., ATR threshold) to only place orders when sufficient volatility is expected
Add spread filter and slippage protection to avoid being triggered under unfavorable trading conditions
Implement dynamic distance adjustment to automatically calculate pending order distance based on current market volatility

risk_points: 双向挂单可能同时被触发导致双倍风险暴露
时间驱动策略缺乏市场状态判断，可能在低波动时段无效开仓
无法确认是否实现了完整的仓位检查和止损机制
risk_points_en: Dual pending orders may both be triggered leading to double risk exposure
Time-driven strategy lacks market state assessment, may open ineffective positions during low volatility
Cannot confirm whether full position checks and stop loss mechanisms are implemented
